split: Original synthetic768TRAIN/235VAL and YCB scenes0..7TRAIN3400/8..9VAL800; no current data.
input_binding: Public pack manifest/seal/lineage + source-only query-emulation seal must be bound by separate pre-fit SOURCE_INPUT_BINDINGS.json, then exact trainer entrylock; no choices changed there.
architecture: V75 encoder/context/fusion + first classifier linear transferred. Remove reference_localizer and learned attention. Validity-weighted query-centered3x3 fused-feature mean24 +fullcrop valid max24 +target24+context16+fractions2 ->90->32GELU->binary1. New last linear weight/bias=0, old DES output excluded. No pose/location prediction.

target.meaning: Reference-local expected target support weak teacher. Not query-pixel presence or human semantic DES.
target.self_visibility: Separate self proxy unchanged; S+localVISIBLE may coexist. No self-to-covered relabel.
target.loss_admission: GTteacherknown0/1 AND factual query_center_valid AND ROI_anyvalid AND local_valid96.any AND target_valid128.any AND GTref finite AND GTref inside unchanged q square: -0.5 <= (r-q)/L <0.5 in both axes. Reference/query invalid, miss, U ->zero loss; all retained.
target.boundary: Include near-boundary teacher labels using already frozen observed-image rules; report boundary and strong/fallback branches separately. No quality or teacher ratio filtering beyond label0/1.

loss: Unweighted binary cross entropy with logits, mean over sampled admitted queries. No location auxiliary, no self-class loss, no pseudo semanticU class, no GT-derived spatial forward.

sampling.augmentation: Public queries only: frozen synthTRAIN correlated error emulation defined separately. No RGB/random query online augment, no current error fitting.

checkpoint_selection.criterion: Minimum equal arithmetic mean BCE over four source x class VAL strata; all nonempty required; strict lower only, earliest tie. Updates100..2000 eligible, update0 diagnostic only.
checkpoint_selection.validation_is_conditional: Public GT-derived emulated query validation, not actual initializer/end-to-end. Synthetic235 includes84 V75 source-selection reused rows, not a fresh independent test.

report: All four source/partition strata CM, P/R, macroNLL, label/query/input/admission coverage, U/miss counts, strong/fallback/boundary/self proxy separately, selected model hashes and update; fixed .5 with no confidence U threshold.
current_evaluation: After source-selected weights freeze only, apply once to all unchanged223 stored inputs. Compare v61/legacy and last V72 saved outputs by wood/square,D/E vs D/S, manual-error<=3px and fixed bins. Raw binary support transfer and same old saved self geometry gate separately. Preserve unknown/missing; no current-based model/threshold selection. PnP0.
execution: One fit; generated loss/sampler/forward and source GPU preflight first. Preserve exact failed code/protocol/log before pre-update repair. Never silently restart after optimizer update1.
